name: Macquarie Park Data Centre (Athena, 11-17 Khartoum Rd)

address.value: 11-17 Khartoum Road and 33-39 Talavera Road, Macquarie Park NSW
address.note: M_Park Building B ('Athena'); 1.296 ha site; five-storey building, GFA 12,069 sqm, 45 m high

postcode.note: suburb postcode (Australia Post); not stated in source

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 11 Khartoum Road (site is 11-17 Khartoum Rd and 33-39 Talavera Rd)

builder.note: CTMP for bulk excavation and construction of Building B (Oct 2021) was prepared for Hutchinson Builders as the constructing contractor; not confirmed by a contractor/owner release

developer.note: applicant/owner. Operator/tenant is AWS: the approved operational complaints procedure is titled 'AWS Stockland Complaints Management Procedure' (Nov 2023) and routes complaints to Amazon (source 11)

mw_it.note: IT MW not stated in planning documents. AECOM operational noise compliance report (Sep 2025): 'the cooling load capacity of the Data Centre is 32 MW' (measured cooling load 7.6-8.5 MW at 50% floor occupancy); 18 x 2.4MW + 1 x 0.6MW back-up generators approved. Clearly >= 5 MW

mw_grid.note: not stated; cooling load capacity 32 MW (source 12)

cost_aud_m.note: capital investment value $263,626,022 (Assessment Report; Currie & Brown CIV estimate, excl. GST, excl. land). DCD's A$264m matches; IREI '$200m' headline is not supported

authority.note: Minister for Planning and Public Spaces consent authority; determined by Director under delegation

lodged.note: approximate: EIS and CIV report uploaded to the major projects portal 18 Nov 2020; exhibition notice Dec 2020

determined.note: Determination Date 28/05/2021 on planning portal (verified 2026-09-27); decider Director

jobs_construction.note: EIS: 'It is estimated that there would be a peak of approximately 250 staff on-site at any one time during construction'

jobs_construction_other.note: EIS: 'The Proposal would employ up to 400 full-time equivalent (FTE) positions during construction'; Assessment Report: 'up to 400 construction jobs'
EIS summary: 'Provide up to 350 - 400 jobs during construction' (lower bound of range)

jobs_operational.note: EIS: 'would accommodate up to 50 full-time staff'; Assessment Report: '50 full-time equivalent operational jobs'

construction_start.note: Stockland letter (5 Oct 2021) nominated commencement on 8 Oct 2021 subject to approval of construction management plans, which DPIE approved 12 Oct 2021. Assessment Report had planned Jun 2021-Feb 2022

construction_end.note: completion date not found. Operating by Nov 2023 (AWS operational complaints procedure lodged); DPHI letter of 17 Feb 2026 'understands the development has commenced full operation' (full-operation noise monitoring done 19 May 2025). The 1-5 Khartoum Rd Assessment Report (2026) calls it an existing data centre

open_questions: construction_end: practical completion / first operation date not found (operating by Nov 2023)
mw_it not stated (32 MW cooling load capacity)
